rows.label: qst620201_msg0001
rows.name: Look...

rows.label: qst620201_msg0002
rows.name:
This field used to be full of
vegetables, but now it is completely
empty.

rows.label: qst620201_msg0003
rows.name:
It doesn't look like that is because
the harvest is over...

rows.label: qst620201_msg0004
rows.name: Right.

rows.label: qst620201_msg0005
rows.name:
Someone stole all the vegetables
overnight. The old woman's field next
door was untouched, though.

rows.label: qst620201_msg0006
rows.name: We can't let them get away with that!

rows.label: qst620201_msg0007
rows.name:
Stealing vegetables the old man grew
with sweat and tears, day after day,
through rain and storms!

rows.label: qst620201_msg0008
rows.name:
Well... I haven't worked quite that
hard...

rows.label: qst620201_msg0009
rows.name:
Either way, stealing someone else's
things is the work of a villain.

rows.label: qst620201_msg0010
rows.name: It might not have been a person.

rows.label: qst620201_msg0011
rows.name:
Tirkin or monster, it makes no
difference.

rows.label: qst620201_msg0012
rows.name:
Whoever it was, I shall go punish
them...

rows.label: qst620201_msg0013
rows.name: Vasara!

rows.label: qst620201_msg0014
rows.name: He never listens to anyone, does he?

rows.label: qst620201_msg0015
rows.name:
I'll go from house to house and talk
to the villagers!

rows.label: qst620201_msg0016
rows.name: Maybe someone saw something...

rows.label: qst620201_msg0017
rows.name:
Or if I find the culprit, I'll
persuade them to confess!!

rows.label: qst620201_msg0018
rows.name: See you!

rows.label: qst620201_msg0019
rows.name: ...Sigh.

rows.label: qst620201_msg0020
rows.name:
Those two really are alike, especially
in how strong their sense of justice
is.

rows.label: qst620201_msg0021
rows.name:
I think I should watch the field here.
The culprit may come for the remaining
vegetables.

rows.label: qst620201_msg0022
rows.name:
What do you think? Will you leave this
to me?

rows.label: qst620201_msg0023
rows.name:
Thank you. I'll make sure I live up to
your expectations.

rows.label: qst620201_msg0024
rows.name:
...So you lot are going to find
whoever stole the vegetables?

rows.label: qst620201_msg0025
rows.name:
That'd be a great help. I'm counting
on you.
